identity_and_scope.principle: There is no single Human culture and no automatic Human=Earth=Federation mapping.

values_and_norms.rule: Do not promote late-24th-century Earth social norms into universal Human biology or all-era Human culture.

communication_and_conflict.rule: Communication priors come from attached regional, household, institutional and individual culture refs, not species.

rules: Human species does not grant Federation authority.
Earth origin does not grant Federation-wide political authority.
Starfleet rank belongs to organization state, not Human culture.

privacy_and_intimacy.note: Use individual/household/regional culture state. Do not impose a contemporary Earth privacy model universally.

rules: No universal Human household form is imposed.
Biological parentage, legal/social parentage and household remain distinct.
Colonial or multispecies households may differ strongly from Earth-local norms.

education_and_socialization.rule: Education context must be attached separately; Earth, colony, Federation and Starfleet education are not interchangeable.

work_service_and_profession.rule: Profession and service are not inferred from species, citizenship or culture.

religion_philosophy_or_worldview.rule: No single Human religion, secularism or philosophy is assigned at species level.

mourning_death_and_legacy.rule: Use local/household/individual culture state; no universal Human mourning duration.

era_variation.rule: Earth/Federation norms can change substantially between Pike, Kirk and TNG/DS9/Voyager eras.

ai_guardrails: Do not use Human as a cultural default for the galaxy.
Do not equate Human with Earth-raised.
Do not equate Earth-raised with Federation citizen.
Do not infer religion, family form, political belief or profession from Human species.
When no culture_ref exists, prefer uncertainty over invented Earth norms.
unknowns: universal Human marriage or inheritance rules

provenance.claim_scope: Human cultural diversity and Earth/colony distinction
